items.prompt:
A computer is best described as an electronic device that accepts data, processes it and produces:

A) Information as output
B) Electricity as output
C) Paper as output
D) Raw data as output

The earliest known device used for counting and simple calculation was the:

A) Laptop
B) Abacus
C) Calculator chip
D) Microprocessor

The Pascaline, an early mechanical adding machine, was invented by:

A) Charles Babbage
B) Bill Gates
C) Blaise Pascal
D) Alan Turing

The man widely regarded as the 'father of the computer' for designing the Analytical Engine is:

A) Blaise Pascal
B) John Napier
C) Herman Hollerith
D) Charles Babbage

The person often described as the first computer programmer for her work on the Analytical Engine is:

A) Ada Lovelace
B) Grace Hopper
C) Charles Babbage
D) Alan Turing

The main electronic component used in first-generation computers was the:

A) Transistor
B) Vacuum tube
C) Integrated circuit
D) Microprocessor

Second-generation computers were built mainly using:

A) Vacuum tubes
B) Microprocessors
C) Transistors
D) Mechanical gears

Third-generation computers were characterised by the use of:

A) Vacuum tubes
B) Transistors only
C) Mechanical relays
D) Integrated circuits

The fourth generation of computers is associated with the invention of the:

A) Microprocessor
B) Vacuum tube
C) Punched card
D) Mechanical gear

Fifth-generation computing is mainly associated with the development of:

A) Vacuum tubes
B) Artificial intelligence
C) Punched cards
D) The abacus

mcq_options.text: Very large, slow and generated much heat

items.prompt:
Compared with modern computers, first-generation (vacuum-tube) computers were generally:

A) Very small, fast and cool
B) Pocket-sized and battery powered
C) Very large, slow and generated much heat
D) Made of integrated circuits
items.correct_answer: C) Very large, slow and generated much heat

items.prompt:
ENIAC, one of the earliest general-purpose electronic computers, belonged to the:

A) Third generation
B) Fourth generation
C) Fifth generation
D) First generation

The punched-card tabulating machine used for census data was developed by:

A) Herman Hollerith
B) Blaise Pascal
C) Ada Lovelace
D) Tim Berners-Lee

The calculating aid made of numbered rods and known as 'Napier's bones' was invented by:

A) Charles Babbage
B) John Napier
C) Blaise Pascal
D) George Boole

Across the computer generations, the general trend in size and speed has been that computers became:

A) Larger and slower
B) Larger and faster
C) Smaller and faster
D) Smaller and slower

The transistor, which replaced the bulky vacuum tube, was a key invention of the:

A) First generation
B) Fourth generation
C) Fifth generation
D) Second generation

A single chip that contains the complete central processing unit is called a:

A) Microprocessor
B) Monitor
C) Modem
D) Mouse

Which of the following is a common everyday use of computers?

A) Generating rainfall
B) Word processing and record keeping
C) Growing crops without farmers
D) Producing electricity from nothing
items.correct_answer: B) Word processing and record keeping

mcq_options.text: Many electronic components built onto a single small chip

items.prompt:
An integrated circuit (IC) is best described as:

A) A single large vacuum tube
B) A mechanical gear system
C) Many electronic components built onto a single small chip
D) A length of copper wire
items.correct_answer: C) Many electronic components built onto a single small chip

mcq_options.text: Transistor, vacuum tube, microprocessor, integrated circuit
Microprocessor, integrated circuit, transistor, vacuum tube
Integrated circuit, microprocessor, vacuum tube, transistor
Vacuum tube, transistor, integrated circuit, microprocessor

items.prompt:
Which sequence correctly orders the main components by generation, first to fourth?

A) Transistor, vacuum tube, microprocessor, integrated circuit
B) Microprocessor, integrated circuit, transistor, vacuum tube
C) Integrated circuit, microprocessor, vacuum tube, transistor
D) Vacuum tube, transistor, integrated circuit, microprocessor
items.correct_answer: D) Vacuum tube, transistor, integrated circuit, microprocessor

items.prompt:
The physical, touchable parts of a computer system are collectively called:

A) Hardware
B) Software
C) Firmware
D) Data

Which of the following is an input device?

A) Monitor
B) Keyboard
C) Printer
D) Speaker

Which of the following is an output device?

A) Keyboard
B) Mouse
C) Printer
D) Scanner

The device used to point at and select items on the screen is the:

A) Printer
B) Microphone
C) Hard disk
D) Mouse

The input device used to convert a printed document into a digital image is the:

A) Scanner
B) Plotter
C) Speaker
D) Monitor

The monitor (VDU) is classified as a/an:

A) Input device
B) Output device
C) Storage device
D) Processing device

The part of the computer often called the 'brain' of the system is the:

A) Monitor
B) Keyboard
C) Central processing unit (CPU)
D) Printer

The unit of the CPU that carries out arithmetic and logical operations is the:

A) Control unit
B) Main memory
C) Hard disk
D) Arithmetic and logic unit (ALU)

The unit of the CPU that directs and coordinates the operations of the computer is the:

A) Control unit
B) Arithmetic and logic unit
C) Printer
D) Monitor

Main memory that loses its contents when power is switched off is the:

A) ROM
B) RAM
C) Hard disk
D) CD-ROM

Memory that holds permanent start-up instructions and is not lost when power is off is the:

A) RAM
B) Cache only
C) ROM
D) Register only

A key difference between RAM and ROM is that RAM is:

A) Non-volatile while ROM is volatile
B) Slower than secondary storage
C) Used only for printing
D) Volatile while ROM is non-volatile
items.correct_answer: D) Volatile while ROM is non-volatile

items.prompt:
Memory that the CPU can access directly and quickly during processing is called:

A) Primary (main) storage
B) Secondary storage
C) Backup storage
D) Offline storage

Which of the following is an example of a secondary storage device?

A) ALU
B) Hard disk
C) Control unit
D) Register

A magnetic storage device that stores large amounts of data inside the system unit is the:

A) Mouse
B) Monitor
C) Hard disk
D) Keyboard

mcq_options.text: Laser-readable pits on a reflective surface

items.prompt:
A CD-ROM stores data using:

A) Magnetic ink
B) Punched holes in paper
C) Static electricity in tubes
D) Laser-readable pits on a reflective surface
items.correct_answer: D) Laser-readable pits on a reflective surface

items.prompt:
A small portable storage device that plugs into a USB port is commonly called a:

A) Flash drive
B) Hard disk platter
C) Floppy disk
D) Magnetic tape

The case that houses the motherboard, CPU and main components is called the:

A) Monitor
B) System unit
C) Keyboard
D) Mouse

The main circuit board to which the CPU, memory and other components connect is the:

A) Hard disk
B) Power cable
C) Motherboard
D) Printer port

Devices connected to but outside the main system unit, such as printers and scanners, are called:

A) Microprocessors
B) Registers
C) Buses
D) Peripheral devices

Very small, very fast storage locations inside the CPU used to hold data being processed are called:

A) Registers
B) Hard disks
C) Optical disks
D) Magnetic tapes

A small, very fast memory placed between the CPU and main memory to speed up access is called:

A) Magnetic tape
B) Cache memory
C) Floppy disk
D) Plotter

Which of the following is normally the FASTEST type of storage?

A) Hard disk
B) Magnetic tape
C) CPU register
D) Optical disk

The output device best suited for printing large engineering and architectural drawings is the:

A) Mouse
B) Scanner
C) Keyboard
D) Plotter

The flat pointing surface used in place of a mouse on most laptops is the:

A) Touchpad
B) Monitor
C) Printer
D) Speaker

A set of instructions that tells the computer what to do is called:

A) Hardware
B) Software
C) A peripheral
D) A monitor

Software that manages and controls the computer hardware itself is called:

A) Application software
B) A spreadsheet
C) System software
D) A web page

Software written to help the user perform a specific task, such as typing a letter, is called:

A) System software
B) An operating system
C) A device driver
D) Application software

The most important system software, which controls overall operation of the computer, is the:

A) Operating system
B) Word processor
C) Web browser
D) Spreadsheet

Which of the following is an example of an operating system?

A) Microsoft Word
B) Windows
C) Google Chrome
D) Adobe Photoshop

Which of the following is a function of an operating system?

A) Designing the printer casing
B) Generating electricity
C) Managing memory and hardware resources
D) Manufacturing the CPU
items.correct_answer: C) Managing memory and hardware resources

items.prompt:
An anti-virus program that helps maintain the computer is an example of:

A) An operating system
B) A spreadsheet
C) A database
D) Utility software

The small program that allows the operating system to communicate with a specific hardware device is a:

A) Device driver
B) Spreadsheet
C) Web browser
D) Compiler

Which of the following is an application package used mainly for calculations and tables?

A) Operating system
B) Spreadsheet
C) Device driver
D) Antivirus

The application package used mainly to create and edit text documents is a:

A) Spreadsheet
B) Database
C) Word processor
D) Web browser

The application package used to store and manage large collections of related data is a:

A) Word processor
B) Presentation package
C) Antivirus
D) Database management system

Software that may be used free of charge but whose rights are kept by the author is called:

A) Freeware
B) Hardware
C) Firmware
D) Malware

Software whose source code is made freely available for users to study and modify is described as:

A) Proprietary software
B) Open-source software
C) Vacuum-tube software
D) Read-only software

Commercial software that must be paid for and whose source code is kept secret is described as:

A) Open-source software
B) Freeware
C) Proprietary software
D) Public-domain software

Software permanently stored in ROM that controls a device at start-up is known as:

A) Application software
B) A web page
C) A spreadsheet
D) Firmware

The process of starting up a computer and loading the operating system is called:

A) Booting
B) Formatting
C) Compiling
D) Debugging

An interface that lets users interact with the computer using icons, windows and a mouse is a:

A) Command-line interface
B) Graphical user interface (GUI)
C) Punched-card interface
D) Mechanical interface

An interface in which the user types text commands to operate the computer is a:

A) Graphical user interface
B) Touch interface
C) Command-line interface
D) Voice interface

An operating system that allows several programs to appear to run at the same time supports:

A) Single instruction only
B) No memory
C) Only printing
D) Multitasking

Organising data on disk into named files and folders is mainly handled by the:

A) Operating system
B) Monitor
C) Printer
D) Keyboard

Programs written in a high-level language must be translated before the computer can run them because the CPU only understands:

A) English sentences
B) Machine code (binary)
C) Flowchart symbols
D) Decimal words

mcq_options.text: Software is the physical equipment; hardware is the instructions
Software is a set of instructions; hardware is the physical equipment
Both are sets of instructions only

items.prompt:
Which statement best distinguishes software from hardware?

A) Software is the physical equipment; hardware is the instructions
B) Both are physical components
C) Software is a set of instructions; hardware is the physical equipment
D) Both are sets of instructions only
items.correct_answer: C) Software is a set of instructions; hardware is the physical equipment
